ex.en: The assignment took me longer than I had expected.
ex.zh: 這份作業花了我比預期還久的時間。

ex.en: The assignment is due next Monday.
ex.zh: 這份作業下週一要交。

assignment.en: a piece of work given to a student

ex.en: It's necessary that we all work together to complete this assignment.
ex.zh: 我們必須同心協力才能完成這項任務。

ex.en: I was abroad on an assignment.
ex.zh: 我那時被派到國外出任務。

assignment.en: a job given to someone as part of their work

ex.en: Students are graded by continuous assessment.
ex.zh: 學生的成績是透過持續評量來決定的。

ex.en: We need a careful assessment of the risks.
ex.zh: 我們需要仔細評估風險。

assessment.en: a judgment about the quality or value of someone or something

ex.en: This bookcase is easy to assemble.
ex.zh: 這個書架很容易組裝。

ex.en: I'll keep the instructions you sent for assembling the furniture.
ex.zh: 你寄來的家具組裝說明，我會留著。

assemble.en: to put the parts of something together

ex.en: The teacher assembled the students in the hall.
ex.zh: 老師把學生集合在禮堂。

ex.en: Where are we assembling?
ex.zh: 我們在哪裡集合？

assemble.en: to come together or bring people together in one place

ex.en: We must consider the financial aspects of this project.
ex.zh: 我們必須考慮這項專案的財務層面。

ex.en: Imagination affects every aspect of our lives.
ex.zh: 想像力影響我們生活的每個層面。

ex.en: He stressed the convenient aspects of city life.
ex.zh: 他強調都市生活便利的一面。

aspect.en: one part or feature of a situation or idea

ex.en: The furniture requires some assembly.
ex.zh: 這件家具需要自己組裝一下。

ex.en: He works on an assembly line.
ex.zh: 他在生產線上工作。

assembly.en: the putting together of the parts of something

ex.en: Where is the assembly point?
ex.zh: 集合地點在哪裡？

ex.en: The school holds an assembly every Monday.
ex.zh: 學校每週一舉行朝會。

assembly.en: a meeting of a large group of people, such as in a school

ex.en: As soon as I sat down, I fell asleep.
ex.zh: 我一坐下就睡著了。

ex.en: I was so excited that I couldn't fall asleep.
ex.zh: 我興奮到睡不著。

ex.en: The baby was sound asleep in her mother's arms.
ex.zh: 寶寶在媽媽懷裡睡得很熟。

ex.en: He gave me his assurance that the work would be done on time.
ex.zh: 他向我保證工作會準時完成。

ex.en: We have received assurances from the supplier.
ex.zh: 我們已經得到供應商的保證。

assurance.en: a promise that something is true or will happen

ex.en: She spoke with great assurance.
ex.zh: 她說話非常有自信。

ex.en: He handled the interview with quiet assurance.
ex.zh: 他從容自信地應對面試。

assurance.en: a feeling of being sure about yourself

ex.en: She works in quality assurance.
ex.zh: 她在品保部門工作。

ex.en: All products go through quality assurance testing.
ex.zh: 所有產品都要經過品保測試。

assurance.en: the work of checking that products or services are good enough

ex.en: He asserted that the report was accurate.
ex.zh: 他堅稱報告是正確的。

ex.en: The company asserts that its products are safe.
ex.zh: 公司聲稱其產品很安全。

assert.en: to say firmly that something is true

assert.zh: 維護（權利）；展現（權威）、表現主見

ex.en: You need to assert yourself more in meetings.
ex.zh: 你在會議上要更有主見一點。

ex.en: The new CEO quickly asserted her authority.
ex.zh: 新執行長很快就樹立了權威。

assert.en: to show your opinions or power in a firm and confident way

ex.en: He was charged with assault.
ex.zh: 他被控傷害罪。

ex.en: The army launched an assault at dawn.
ex.zh: 軍隊在黎明時發動攻擊。

assault.en: a violent attack on a person

ex.en: The man was accused of assaulting a security guard.
ex.zh: 那名男子被控攻擊一名警衛。

ex.en: She was assaulted on her way home.
ex.zh: 她在回家的路上遭到襲擊。

ex.en: He applied for political asylum in Canada.
ex.zh: 他向加拿大申請政治庇護。

ex.en: The government granted asylum to the refugees.
ex.zh: 政府給予那些難民庇護。

asylum.en: protection given by a country to people who have left their own country for safety

ex.en: Tom refuted that assertion with a counterexample.
ex.zh: 湯姆用一個反例駁斥了那個說法。

ex.en: There is no evidence to support his assertion.
ex.zh: 沒有證據支持他的說法。

assertion.en: a statement saying firmly that something is true

ex.en: As I was leaving, the phone rang.
ex.zh: 我正要離開時，電話響了。

ex.en: Prices go up as demand increases.
ex.zh: 隨著需求增加，價格跟著上漲。

as.en: used to say that two things happen at the same time

ex.en: She works as a designer.
ex.zh: 她擔任設計師。

ex.en: I used the box as a table.
ex.zh: 我把箱子當桌子用。

as.en: used to say what job or purpose someone or something has

ex.en: As you know, the office will be closed tomorrow.
ex.zh: 如你所知，辦公室明天不開。

ex.en: Please do it as I showed you.
ex.zh: 請照我示範給你看的方式做。

as.en: used to say that something is done or happens in the same way

ex.en: You don't get up as early as your sister.
ex.zh: 你起得沒有你姐姐那麼早。

ex.en: This laptop is as fast as mine.
ex.zh: 這台筆電和我的一樣快。

as.en: used to compare two things that are equal in some way

ex.en: And yet, the contrary is always true as well.
ex.zh: 然而，反過來說也永遠成立。

ex.en: I'd like a coffee as well.
ex.zh: 我也想要一杯咖啡。

ex.en: Mr. Sato asked me many questions about the election.
ex.zh: 佐藤先生問了我很多關於選舉的問題。

ex.en: You can ask the child who's playing over there.
ex.zh: 你可以問在那裡玩的那個小孩。

ask.en: to say something to a person to get an answer or information

ex.en: I asked Mother to wake me up at four.
ex.zh: 我請媽媽四點叫我起床。

ex.en: We will help him if he asks us.
ex.zh: 如果他開口，我們就會幫他。

ask.en: to tell someone that you want them to do something

ex.en: Don't be afraid to ask for help.
ex.zh: 不要害怕開口求助。

ex.en: The customer asked for a refund.
ex.zh: 那位顧客要求退款。

ask.en: to say that you want to be given something

ex.en: He asked me to dinner.
ex.zh: 他邀我去吃晚餐。

ex.en: Tom asked Amy to the party.
ex.zh: 湯姆邀請艾咪參加派對。

ask.en: to invite someone to go somewhere or join you

ex.en: We associate Darwin with the theory of evolution.
ex.zh: 我們一提到達爾文就會想到進化論。

ex.en: For many individuals, the pentatonic scale is associated with Chinese music.
ex.zh: 很多人會把五聲音階和中國音樂聯想在一起。

associate.en: to connect one thing with another in your mind

ex.en: Don't associate yourself with people that give up easily.
ex.zh: 別跟輕易放棄的人來往。

ex.en: I don't want to associate with people like him.
ex.zh: 我不想跟他那種人來往。

ex.en: Dan lied to his associates.
ex.zh: Dan 對他的夥伴說謊。

ex.en: She is a business associate of mine.
ex.zh: 她是我的生意夥伴。

associate.en: a person you work with or do business with

ex.en: He is an associate professor at the university.
ex.zh: 他是那所大學的副教授。

ex.en: She was promoted to associate director last year.
ex.zh: 她去年升為副總監。

associate.en: having a position just below the top level

ex.en: She assumed that everyone would be for the plan.
ex.zh: 她以為大家都會贊成這個計畫。

ex.en: I assume that you wouldn't want to do that.
ex.zh: 我想你應該不會想那樣做吧。

ex.en: Let's assume this is correct for now.
ex.zh: 我們姑且先假設這是對的。

assume.en: to think that something is true without checking

ex.en: She will assume the role of manager next month.
ex.zh: 她下個月將接任經理一職。

ex.en: The company assumed full responsibility for the error.
ex.zh: 公司為這個錯誤承擔了全部責任。

assume.en: to take on a duty or position

ex.en: She can assess investments very accurately.
ex.zh: 她能非常準確地評估投資。

ex.en: The purpose of this interview is to assess whether or not you are suitable for the company.
ex.zh: 這次面試的目的是評估你是否適合這家公司。

ex.en: We need to assess the damage first.
ex.zh: 我們需要先評估損害情況。

assess.en: to judge how good, large or important something is

ex.en: He has over a million dollars in assets.
ex.zh: 他擁有超過一百萬美元的資產。

ex.en: The company's total assets are worth 5 billion dollars.
ex.zh: 這家公司的總資產價值五十億元。

asset.en: something that a person or company owns that has value

ex.en: Youth is an asset.
ex.zh: 年輕就是本錢。

ex.en: She is a real asset to our team.
ex.zh: 她是我們團隊不可或缺的人才。

asset.en: a useful quality or person that helps you succeed

ex.en: I applied for membership in the association.
ex.zh: 我申請加入這個協會。

ex.en: The association counts thirty members.
ex.zh: 這個協會有三十名會員。

association.en: an organized group of people with the same interest or job

ex.en: In Taiwan, red has a strong association with good luck.
ex.zh: 在台灣，紅色常讓人聯想到好運。

ex.en: Some people have bad associations with hospitals.
ex.zh: 有些人對醫院有不好的聯想。

association.en: a connection in the mind between two things

ex.en: The event is organized in association with the city government.
ex.zh: 這場活動與市政府合辦。

ex.en: The show was made in association with a local TV station.
ex.zh: 這個節目是和一家地方電視台合作製作的。

association.en: together with another person or group

ex.en: I worked three years as Tom's assistant.
ex.zh: 我當了湯姆三年的助理。

ex.en: I need an assistant who speaks French.
ex.zh: 我需要一位會說法語的助理。

ex.en: I am looking for an assistant.
ex.zh: 我正在找助理。

assistant.en: a person whose job is to help someone more senior

ex.en: Tom got a job as assistant manager.
ex.zh: 湯姆找到一份副理的工作。

ex.en: He works as an assistant professor.
ex.zh: 他擔任助理教授。

assistant.en: having a job just below the main person

ex.en: What is the basis of your assumptions?
ex.zh: 你的假設是根據什麼？

ex.en: That's a pretty big assumption.
ex.zh: 這個假設未免太大膽了。

ex.en: That's an assumption.
ex.zh: 這只是一個假設。

assumption.en: something that you accept as true without proof

ex.en: She pulled me aside.
ex.zh: 她把我拉到一旁。

ex.en: He pulled aside to let a truck pass.
ex.zh: 他把車靠邊讓卡車通過。

ex.en: Joking aside, how are things going?
ex.zh: 說正經的，事情進展得如何？

aside.en: to one side or away from the middle

aside.zh: put / set aside：擱置；存下、撥出（錢或時間）

ex.en: She put aside the sewing and stood up.
ex.zh: 她放下手邊的針線活，站了起來。

ex.en: I set aside some money every month.
ex.zh: 我每個月都存一點錢。

aside.en: to stop doing something for now, or to keep money or time for later

ex.en: But you know, I have nothing aside from this.
ex.zh: 但你知道，除了這些我什麼都沒有。

ex.en: Aside from the price, I like everything about it.
ex.zh: 除了價格之外，其他我都很滿意。

aside.en: used to show that you are not including a person or thing

ex.en: Thank you for your assistance.
ex.zh: 謝謝您的協助。

ex.en: Do you need our assistance?
ex.zh: 您需要我們協助嗎？

ex.en: Your assistance is indispensable for us.
ex.zh: 您的協助對我們來說不可或缺。

ex.en: I assure you that the problem will be fixed today.
ex.zh: 我向您保證問題今天就會解決。

ex.en: The manager assured us that the order would arrive on time.
ex.zh: 經理向我們保證訂單會準時送達。

assure.en: to tell someone firmly that something is true so they do not worry

ex.en: Rest assured, your data is safe with us.
ex.zh: 請放心，您的資料在我們這裡很安全。

ex.en: Rest assured that we will handle the problem.
ex.zh: 請放心，我們會處理這個問題。

assure.en: used to tell someone not to worry

ex.en: I would like you to assist me with my gardening.
ex.zh: 我想請你幫我整理花園。

ex.en: I'm here to assist you.
ex.zh: 我是來協助您的。

ex.en: I'll be able to assist you.
ex.zh: 我可以協助您。

ex.en: I'm very ashamed of myself about what I've done.
ex.zh: 我對自己做的事感到很羞愧。

ex.en: I'm not ashamed of my father being poor.
ex.zh: 我不會因為父親窮而感到丟臉。

ex.en: She was ashamed of herself for her carelessness.
ex.zh: 她為自己的粗心感到羞愧。

ashamed.en: feeling bad because of something wrong or foolish you did

ex.en: She will be the first Japanese woman astronaut.
ex.zh: 她將成為日本第一位女性太空人。

ex.en: The astronauts prepared for launch.
ex.zh: 太空人們為發射做準備。

ex.en: The man whom she is going to marry is an astronaut.
ex.zh: 她要嫁的那個男人是一位太空人。

astronaut.en: a person who travels in space

ex.en: It seems that he is interested in astronomy.
ex.zh: 他好像對天文學挺有興趣。

ex.en: Astronomy deals with the stars and planets.
ex.zh: 天文學涉及恆星和行星。

ex.en: What's the difference between astronomy and astrology?
ex.zh: 「astronomy」和「astrology」有什麼區別？

astronomy.en: the scientific study of the stars and planets

ex.en: His memory never ceases to astonish me.
ex.zh: 他的記憶力總讓我吃驚。

ex.en: We were astonished to hear what had happened.
ex.zh: 我們聽到所發生的事，感到很驚訝。

ex.en: I was truly astonished.
ex.zh: 我真是驚訝。

ex.en: My head hurts. Maybe I should take an aspirin.
ex.zh: 我頭好痛，也許該吃顆阿斯匹靈。

ex.en: Take two aspirins for your headache.
ex.zh: 你頭痛的話就吃兩顆阿斯匹靈吧。

ex.en: I would like to buy some aspirin.
ex.zh: 我想買一些阿斯匹靈。

aspirin.en: a common medicine that takes away pain and lowers fever

ex.en: You need to be more assertive and say no when you're busy.
ex.zh: 你要更有主見，忙的時候就說不。

ex.en: She is assertive but always polite in meetings.
ex.zh: 她在會議上很果斷自信，但總是很有禮貌。

assertive.en: confident and willing to say what you want

ex.en: She learned to speak assertively in meetings without being rude.
ex.zh: 她學會在會議中堅定地表達意見，又不失禮貌。

ex.en: If your coworker keeps interrupting you, respond calmly but assertively.
ex.zh: 如果同事一直打斷你，要冷靜而堅定地回應。

assertively.en: in a confident way that clearly shows what you want

ex.en: The cars move slowly along the assembly line.
ex.zh: 汽車沿著裝配線緩緩移動。

ex.en: He worked on an assembly line for ten years.
ex.zh: 他在生產線上工作了十年。

assembly line.en: a line of workers or machines that put a product together step by step

ex.en: The asking price is above our budget, but the seller may negotiate.
ex.zh: 開價超出我們的預算，不過賣方可能願意議價。

ex.en: Comparable homes nearby sold below the asking price.
ex.zh: 附近條件相近的房屋成交價都低於開價。

asking price.en: the amount of money that a seller first wants for something

ex.en: The shop offers an assortment of locally made snacks.
ex.zh: 這家店提供各式各樣的本地零食。

ex.en: We ordered an assortment of teas for the client lounge.
ex.zh: 我們為客戶休息室訂購了一系列茶品。

assortment.en: a mixed group of different things

ex.en: My boss assigned the hard job to me.
ex.zh: 我老闆把艱鉅的任務指派給了我。

ex.en: She assigned the work to him.
ex.zh: 她把這個工作派給他做。

ex.en: The teacher assigned us ten problems for homework.
ex.zh: 老師出了十題作業給我們。

assign.en: to give someone a job or duty

ex.en: The astronomer discovered a new star with her telescope.
ex.zh: 那位天文學家用望遠鏡發現了一顆新的星星。

ex.en: My uncle is an astronomer who works at a research center.
ex.zh: 我叔叔是在研究中心工作的天文學家。

ex.en: Heart disease is associated with a lack of exercise.
ex.zh: 心臟病與缺乏運動有關。

ex.en: The costs associated with the trip were higher than expected.
ex.zh: 這趟旅行相關的費用比預期的還高。

ex.en: Many problems are associated with poor sleep.
ex.zh: 許多問題都與睡眠不足有關。

ex.en: There was ash all over the floor near the fireplace.
ex.zh: 壁爐附近的地板上都是灰。

ex.en: The house burned down to ashes.
ex.zh: 那棟房子燒成了灰燼。

ex.en: Her aspiration is to become a doctor one day.
ex.zh: 她的志向是有一天成為醫生。

ex.en: Young people often have high aspirations for the future.
ex.zh: 年輕人對未來往往抱有遠大的志向。

ex.en: She is an Asian who grew up in Canada.
ex.zh: 她是在加拿大長大的亞洲人。

ex.en: Many Asians travel home for the new year holiday.
ex.zh: 許多亞洲人在新年假期回家過年。

ex.en: The store sells many kinds of Asian food.
ex.zh: 這家店賣很多種亞洲食品。

ex.en: He teaches Asian history at a local college.
ex.zh: 他在當地一所大學教亞洲史。

ex.en: Asia is the largest continent in the world.
ex.zh: 亞洲是世界上最大的大陸。

ex.en: She has traveled to many countries in Asia.
ex.zh: 她去過亞洲的許多國家。

ex.en: The assassination of the leader shocked the whole country.
ex.zh: 領導人遭暗殺的消息震驚了全國。

ex.en: Police uncovered a plot for an assassination.
ex.zh: 警方揭發了一項暗殺陰謀。

ex.en: The police are trying to ascertain the cause of the fire.
ex.zh: 警方正試圖查明起火的原因。

ex.en: Please ascertain the facts before you write the report.
ex.zh: 請在寫報告之前先查明事實。

ex.en: The speed of the new train is astonishing.
ex.zh: 這列新火車的速度令人驚訝。

ex.en: She made an astonishing recovery after the accident.
ex.zh: 她在意外之後的復原情形令人驚奇。

ex.en: An asteroid is a small rocky object that moves around the sun.
ex.zh: 小行星是繞著太陽運行的小型岩石天體。

ex.en: Scientists track each asteroid that comes near the Earth.
ex.zh: 科學家追蹤每一顆接近地球的小行星。

ex.en: The movie is about an asteroid heading toward the planet.
ex.zh: 這部電影是關於一顆朝地球飛來的小行星。

ex.en: He carries an inhaler because he has asthma.
ex.zh: 他有氣喘，所以隨身帶著吸入器。

ex.en: Cold air can make her asthma worse.
ex.zh: 冷空氣會讓她的氣喘更嚴重。

ex.en: The museum has an astronomical clock that shows the moon's phases.
ex.zh: 博物館有一座顯示月相的天文鐘。

ex.en: They made some astronomical observations from the mountain top.
ex.zh: 他們在山頂進行了一些天文觀測。

ex.en: The cost of the project was astronomical.
ex.zh: 這個計畫的成本高得像天文數字。

ex.en: Housing prices in the city have risen to astronomical levels.
ex.zh: 這座城市的房價已漲到天文數字般的水準。

ex.en: The lab ran an assay to measure the metal content.
ex.zh: 實驗室進行了化驗來測定金屬含量。

ex.en: The blood assay showed normal results.
ex.zh: 血液檢驗的結果正常。

ex.en: Scientists assayed the water for harmful chemicals.
ex.zh: 科學家化驗了水中是否含有有害化學物質。

ex.en: The lab will assay the sample tomorrow.
ex.zh: 實驗室明天會化驗這份樣本。

ex.en: I was astonished by how fast she learned.
ex.zh: 我對她學得這麼快感到驚訝。

ex.en: He looked astonished when he opened the gift.
ex.zh: 他打開禮物時一臉吃驚。

ex.en: The sailors came ashore after a long trip.
ex.zh: 水手在長途航行後登岸。

ex.en: A few fish washed ashore after the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨後有幾條魚被沖上岸。

ex.en: Many young people aspire to become famous singers.
ex.zh: 許多年輕人立志成為知名歌手。

ex.en: He aspires to open his own restaurant someday.
ex.zh: 他渴望有一天開一間自己的餐廳。

ex.en: She looked at him in astonishment when he told her the news.
ex.zh: 他告訴她那個消息時，她驚訝地看著他。

ex.en: To my astonishment, the whole room fell silent.
ex.zh: 令我驚訝的是，整個房間忽然安靜下來。

ex.en: Doctors ascribe his headaches to stress.
ex.zh: 醫生把他的頭痛歸因於壓力。

ex.en: Don't ascribe bad motives to people without any proof.
ex.zh: 別在沒有證據的情況下就把壞動機加在別人身上。

ex.en: The ascent of the mountain took six hours.
ex.zh: 登上那座山花了六個小時。

ex.en: The balloon's slow ascent gave us a great view.
ex.zh: 氣球緩緩上升，讓我們有絕佳的視野。

ex.en: The road was freshly covered with asphalt.
ex.zh: 這條路剛鋪上新的柏油。

ex.en: The asphalt felt hot under my feet in the summer sun.
ex.zh: 夏天的太陽下，柏油路踩起來很燙。

ex.en: The assassin was arrested soon after the attack.
ex.zh: 刺客在案發後不久就被逮捕。

ex.en: The film is about a hired assassin who changes his life.
ex.zh: 這部電影講的是一位受僱殺手改變人生的故事。

ex.en: Several attempts were made to assassinate the king.
ex.zh: 有人多次企圖暗殺國王。

ex.en: The plot to assassinate the leader failed.
ex.zh: 暗殺那位領袖的陰謀失敗了。

ex.en: It takes time to assimilate so much new information.
ex.zh: 要消化這麼多新資訊需要時間。

ex.en: Plants assimilate nutrients from the soil.
ex.zh: 植物從土壤中吸收養分。

ex.en: The immigrants quickly assimilated into the local community.
ex.zh: 移民們很快就融入了當地社區。

ex.en: It can be hard for newcomers to assimilate into a new culture.
ex.zh: 新來的人要融入新文化可能很困難。

ex.en: Asbestos was once widely used in building materials.
ex.zh: 石棉過去曾被廣泛用在建築材料中。

ex.en: Workers must wear masks when removing asbestos from old buildings.
ex.zh: 工人在清除老建築的石棉時必須戴口罩。

ex.en: An assessor visited the house to estimate its value.
ex.zh: 一位估價員到那間房子評估它的價值。

ex.en: The tax assessor sent us a letter about the new property value.
ex.zh: 稅務估價員寄了一封信告知我們房產的新估值。

ex.en: The assessor will mark your project and give you feedback.
ex.zh: 評審員會替你的專題評分並給你回饋。

ex.en: Each assessor must read every application carefully.
ex.zh: 每位評審員都必須仔細閱讀每一份申請書。

ex.en: We had grilled asparagus with our dinner.
ex.zh: 我們晚餐吃了烤蘆筍。

ex.en: Asparagus is best when it is fresh and green.
ex.zh: 蘆筍新鮮翠綠時最好吃。

ex.en: An assemblage of artists gathered in the hall.
ex.zh: 一群藝術家聚集在大廳裡。

ex.en: The museum displays an assemblage of old tools.
ex.zh: 博物館展示了一批古老的工具。

ex.en: Language classes helped with the immigrants' assimilation into the community.
ex.zh: 語言課程幫助移民融入社區。

ex.en: Cultural assimilation often takes more than one generation.
ex.zh: 文化同化往往需要不只一個世代。

ex.en: The assimilation of nutrients happens mostly in the small intestine.
ex.zh: 養分的吸收主要發生在小腸。

ex.en: Fast assimilation of new information is important for this job.
ex.zh: 這份工作需要快速吸收新資訊。

ex.en: She gave an assured performance on the piano.
ex.zh: 她的鋼琴演奏充滿自信。

ex.en: He spoke in a calm and assured voice.
ex.zh: 他以平靜又篤定的聲音說話。

ex.en: Rest assured, we will fix the problem today.
ex.zh: 請放心，我們今天就會解決這個問題。

ex.en: You can be assured that your information is safe.
ex.zh: 你可以放心，你的資料是安全的。

ex.en: The balloon slowly ascended into the clear sky.
ex.zh: 氣球緩緩升入晴朗的天空。

ex.en: Smoke ascended from the chimney.
ex.zh: 煙從煙囪裡升起。

ex.en: We ascended the steep path to the top of the hill.
ex.zh: 我們沿著陡峭的小徑登上山頂。

ex.en: The climbers ascended the mountain before sunrise.
ex.zh: 登山客在日出前就攀上了山。

assorted.zh: 各式各樣的；什麼都有的

ex.en: She bought a box of assorted chocolates.
ex.zh: 她買了一盒什錦巧克力。

ex.en: The shelf was full of assorted books and toys.
ex.zh: 架子上擺滿了各種書和玩具。

ex.en: We ordered assorted sushi for the party.
ex.zh: 我們為派對訂了綜合壽司。

ex.en: The committee gave its assent to the plan.
ex.zh: 委員會同意了這項計畫。

ex.en: He nodded in assent and sat down.
ex.zh: 他點頭表示同意後坐了下來。

ex.en: The manager assented to our request for more time.
ex.zh: 經理同意了我們多給一些時間的請求。

ex.en: She assented to the changes without complaint.
ex.zh: 她毫無怨言地同意了這些更動。

ex.en: He is an aspiring actor who takes acting classes at night.
ex.zh: 他是個想成為演員的人，晚上都去上表演課。

ex.en: The workshop is open to aspiring writers of all ages.
ex.zh: 這場工作坊歡迎各年齡層有志寫作的人參加。

assembled.zh: 集合；組裝（過去式／過去分詞）

ex.en: The students assembled in the gym for the speech.
ex.zh: 學生們集合到體育館聽演講。

ex.en: He assembled the bookshelf in less than an hour.
ex.zh: 他不到一小時就把書架組裝好了。

ex.en: He put out his cigarette in the ashtray.
ex.zh: 他把香菸在菸灰缸裡熄掉。

ex.en: The restaurant no longer puts an ashtray on each table.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳不再在每張桌上放菸灰缸。

ex.en: The police are still looking for the assailant.
ex.zh: 警方仍在搜尋那名襲擊者。

ex.en: The victim could not describe her assailant to the officers.
ex.zh: 受害者無法向警員描述襲擊她的人的樣貌。

ex.en: The magician's trick will astound the audience.
ex.zh: 魔術師的戲法會讓觀眾大吃一驚。

ex.en: It astounds me that he finished the marathon with a broken toe.
ex.zh: 他腳趾骨折還跑完馬拉松，讓我驚訝不已。

ex.en: Please go to your assigned seat.
ex.zh: 請到你被指定的座位。

ex.en: Each student finished the assigned reading before class.
ex.zh: 每位學生都在上課前讀完了指定的閱讀材料。

ex.en: She is an astute businesswoman who rarely makes mistakes.
ex.zh: 她是個精明的女商人，很少犯錯。

ex.en: His astute comments helped us solve the problem.
ex.zh: 他敏銳的意見幫助我們解決了問題。

assisted.zh: 幫助；協助（assist 的過去式）

ex.en: A nurse assisted the doctor during the surgery.
ex.zh: 護理師在手術中協助醫生。

ex.en: Volunteers assisted the elderly across the street.
ex.zh: 志工協助老人過馬路。

ex.en: The hospital offers assisted living for older people.
ex.zh: 這間醫院為年長者提供協助式照護的居住服務。

ex.en: It was an assisted rescue, so everyone was safe.
ex.zh: 那是一場有人協助的救援，所以大家都平安。

ex.en: The leaves of the aspen turn golden in autumn.
ex.zh: 山楊的葉子在秋天會變成金黃色。

ex.en: We sat in the shade of a tall aspen by the lake.
ex.zh: 我們坐在湖邊一棵高大山楊的樹蔭下。

asking.zh: 問、要求（ask 的現在分詞）

ex.en: I am asking you for a small favor.
ex.zh: 我想請你幫個小忙。

ex.en: Why are you asking so many questions about my job?
ex.zh: 你為什麼一直問這麼多關於我工作的問題？

ex.en: The asking price for the old car was far too high.
ex.zh: 那輛舊車的開價太高了。

ex.en: It was just an asking; you don't have to say yes.
ex.zh: 那只是個請求，你不必答應。

ex.en: The asymmetry of the building makes it look modern.
ex.zh: 這棟建築的不對稱設計讓它看起來很現代。

ex.en: There is a clear asymmetry between the two sides of her face.
ex.zh: 她的臉左右兩側明顯不對稱。

ex.en: Associative thinking helps us link new ideas to old ones.
ex.zh: 聯想式思考能幫助我們把新想法和舊想法連結起來。

ex.en: Smells can trigger strong associative memories.
ex.zh: 氣味會引發強烈的聯想記憶。

assumed.zh: 以為；假定（assume 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: I assumed you had already eaten dinner.
ex.zh: 我以為你已經吃過晚餐了。

ex.en: Everyone assumed the shop was closed because the lights were off.
ex.zh: 大家都以為店關了，因為燈是暗的。

ex.en: She assumed the role of team leader last month.
ex.zh: 她上個月接任了組長的職務。

ex.en: He assumed responsibility for the mistake.
ex.zh: 他為這個錯誤承擔了責任。

ex.en: The writer used an assumed name to protect her family.
ex.zh: 那位作家為了保護家人而使用化名。

ex.en: He traveled under an assumed identity.
ex.zh: 他以假身分旅行。

ex.en: The little boy was astonishingly good at chess.
ex.zh: 那個小男孩下棋出奇地厲害。

ex.en: Astonishingly, nobody was hurt in the crash.
ex.zh: 令人驚訝的是，這場車禍沒有人受傷。

ex.en: The lost sheep wandered astray from the flock.
ex.zh: 那隻迷路的羊走離了羊群。

ex.en: Bad friends led him astray when he was young.
ex.zh: 他年輕時被壞朋友帶入歧途。

ex.en: List the numbers in ascending order from smallest to largest.
ex.zh: 把數字依由小到大的升冪順序排列。

ex.en: We climbed the ascending path to the top of the hill.
ex.zh: 我們沿著向上的小路爬到山頂。

ex.en: The party gained ascendancy in the early years of the century.
ex.zh: 這個政黨在本世紀初取得了優勢地位。

ex.en: Our team has held ascendancy over their rivals all season.
ex.zh: 整個球季我們隊都壓過對手一頭。

ex.en: Critics assailed the plan as a waste of money.
ex.zh: 評論者批評這個計畫是浪費錢。

ex.en: Doubts assailed her as she walked onto the stage.
ex.zh: 她走上舞台時，疑慮不斷襲來。

ex.en: The magician performed an astounding trick.
ex.zh: 魔術師表演了一個令人震驚的把戲。

ex.en: The team made astounding progress in just one year.
ex.zh: 這個團隊僅僅一年就有了驚人的進步。

ex.en: Assertiveness helps you say no politely.
ex.zh: 果斷自信能幫你有禮貌地說不。

ex.en: She took a class to improve her assertiveness at work.
ex.zh: 她上了一堂課來增進自己在工作上的自信表達。

ex.en: The astrophysicist explained how stars are born.
ex.zh: 這位天體物理學家解釋了恆星如何誕生。

ex.en: My cousin wants to become an astrophysicist.
ex.zh: 我表弟想成為天體物理學家。

ex.en: The building has an asymmetrical design.
ex.zh: 這棟建築的設計是不對稱的。

ex.en: Her face is slightly asymmetrical, like most people's.
ex.zh: 她的臉有點不對稱，大多數人都是這樣。

ex.en: The artist likes asymmetrical patterns.
ex.zh: 這位藝術家喜歡不對稱的圖案。

ex.en: She reads astrology to decide which day is lucky.
ex.zh: 她看占星來決定哪天是幸運日。

ex.en: Many scientists say astrology has no scientific basis.
ex.zh: 許多科學家說占星術沒有科學根據。

ex.en: We were astounded by the size of the old tree.
ex.zh: 我們被那棵老樹的大小震懾住了。

ex.en: She stood astounded when she saw the surprise party.
ex.zh: 她看到驚喜派對時，整個人愣住了。

ex.en: A warm drink can assuage a sore throat.
ex.zh: 熱飲可以緩解喉嚨痛。

ex.en: He tried to assuage her fears with kind words.
ex.zh: 他試著用溫和的話語消除她的恐懼。

ex.en: The ascension of the balloon was slow and smooth.
ex.zh: 氣球上升得緩慢而平穩。

ex.en: His ascension to power happened very quickly.
ex.zh: 他登上權力高位的過程非常迅速。

ex.en: Some churches hold special services for the Ascension.
ex.zh: 有些教會會舉行耶穌升天節的特別禮拜。

ex.en: The painting shows the ascension of Christ into the clouds.
ex.zh: 這幅畫描繪基督升入雲中的場景。

ex.en: The monk lived an ascetic life in a small mountain hut.
ex.zh: 那位僧人在山上的小屋過著苦行般的生活。

ex.en: He led an ascetic existence and owned almost nothing.
ex.zh: 他過著禁慾簡樸的生活，幾乎一無所有。

ex.en: The ascetic gave up all comforts to focus on prayer.
ex.zh: 那位苦行者放棄一切享受，專心祈禱。

ex.en: Many an ascetic has walked these quiet paths in search of peace.
ex.zh: 許多苦行者曾走過這些寧靜的小路尋求平靜。

ex.en: The assignee takes over all rights under the contract.
ex.zh: 受讓人接手合約下的一切權利。

ex.en: The company named a new assignee to manage the property.
ex.zh: 公司指派了一位新的受託人來管理這筆財產。

ex.en: The picture on the wall was hanging askew.
ex.zh: 牆上的畫掛歪了。

ex.en: His tie was askew after the long day.
ex.zh: 漫長的一天過後，他的領帶歪了。

ex.en: She wore her hat askew and made everyone laugh.
ex.zh: 她把帽子戴歪，逗得大家哈哈大笑。

ex.en: The sign was nailed askew above the door.
ex.zh: 招牌被歪斜地釘在門上方。

ex.en: She sat astride the horse and rode off.
ex.zh: 她跨坐在馬上騎走了。

ex.en: He stood astride the line with his feet apart.
ex.zh: 他兩腳分開、跨站在線上。

ex.en: An asterisk next to the price means extra fees apply.
ex.zh: 價格旁的星號表示須另加費用。

ex.en: Type an asterisk to search with a wildcard.
ex.zh: 輸入星號即可用萬用字元搜尋。

assistive.zh: 輔助的（為身心障礙者設計）

ex.en: The school provides assistive technology for students with disabilities.
ex.zh: 學校為身心障礙的學生提供輔助科技。

ex.en: She uses an assistive device to help her hear better.
ex.zh: 她使用輔助裝置來幫助自己聽得更清楚。

ex.en: She studied assiduously for the entrance exam.
ex.zh: 她為了入學考試孜孜不倦地讀書。

ex.en: The gardener assiduously watered the plants every morning.
ex.zh: 園丁每天早上都勤快地替植物澆水。

ex.en: His face turned ashen when he heard the news.
ex.zh: 聽到消息時，他的臉色變得慘白。

ex.en: The sky was ashen after the fire.
ex.zh: 大火過後，天空一片灰濛。

ex.en: This is assuredly the best meal I have had all year.
ex.zh: 這無疑是我今年吃過最好的一餐。

ex.en: Assuredly, we will help you move next week.
ex.zh: 我們一定會幫你下週搬家。

ex.en: She studies astrophysics at university.
ex.zh: 她在大學主修天體物理學。

ex.en: Astrophysics explains how stars are born and die.
ex.zh: 天體物理學解釋恆星如何誕生與消亡。

ex.en: Purple asters bloom in the garden every autumn.
ex.zh: 紫色的紫菀每年秋天在花園裡盛開。

ex.en: She picked a bunch of asters for the table.
ex.zh: 她摘了一束紫菀放在桌上。

ex.en: The astrologer read my horoscope for the month.
ex.zh: 占星師為我解讀了這個月的星座運勢。

ex.en: My aunt visits an astrologer before big decisions.
ex.zh: 我阿姨在做重大決定前會去找占星師。

ex.en: My younger brother is asthmatic and carries an inhaler.
ex.zh: 我弟弟有氣喘，隨身帶著吸入器。

ex.en: Cold air can trigger an asthmatic cough.
ex.zh: 冷空氣可能引發氣喘的咳嗽。

ex.en: She speaks English as well as French and Japanese.
ex.zh: 她除了英文，還會說法文和日文。

ex.en: The hotel offers breakfast as well as free parking.
ex.zh: 這間旅館提供早餐，也提供免費停車。

as well as.en: used to add another person or thing to what you have just said

ex.en: He can't sing as well as his sister.
ex.zh: 他唱歌沒有他姊姊唱得好。

ex.en: I'll explain it as well as I can.
ex.zh: 我會盡我所能把它解釋清楚。

as well as.en: used to say that one thing is just as good as another

ex.en: Call me as soon as you get home.
ex.zh: 你一到家就打給我。

ex.en: As soon as the rain stopped, the kids ran outside.
ex.zh: 雨一停，孩子們就跑到外面去了。

ex.en: I'll send the file as soon as I finish editing it.
ex.zh: 我一編輯完就把檔案寄給你。

as soon as.en: used to say that something happens immediately after something else

ex.en: You should ask for help if the work is too hard.
ex.zh: 如果工作太難，你應該要求協助。

ex.en: He asked for a glass of water and sat down.
ex.zh: 他要了一杯水，然後坐下來。

ex.en: She is asking for a day off next week.
ex.zh: 她正在申請下週休一天。

ex.en: A man came to the door and asked for you.
ex.zh: 有個男人來到門口找你。

ex.en: Someone called the office and asked for the manager.
ex.zh: 有人打電話到辦公室找經理。

ask for.en: to say you want to see or speak to someone

ex.en: He finally asked her out to dinner on Friday.
ex.zh: 他終於約她週五一起吃晚餐。

ex.en: I was too shy to ask out the girl in my class.
ex.zh: 我太害羞了，不敢約班上那個女生出去。

ex.en: Has anyone asked you out to the movies yet?
ex.zh: 有人約你去看電影了嗎？

ask out.en: to invite someone to go on a date
